name: visiting-hours-dream-art-pass2
title: Visiting Hours: the dream scenes' art, pass 2 (code side)
subtitle: Night 2's house, dressed over its unchanged blockout: real furniture from Kenney's Furniture Kit (CC0) drawn in the dream's pastel look with a pencil outline, wallpaper and floorboards, both front doors, and the umbrella as real meshes. These need a Unity rebuild to see; the in-game captures go here after main's verify run.
questions: Furniture: the counter, stove and sink, the fridge, the table and four chairs, the sofa, Theo's bed and desk, and the study desk. Does Kenney's chunky low-poly read right in the dream, or should the house be stranger (too big, too tidy, slightly wrong)?
Wallpaper and floorboards are a soft pattern on the existing pastel colours. Stronger, or a crayon-drawn dream pattern instead (a Flow job once the lock is free)?
notes: Not built or seen in Unity yet: please judge the captures, not this page, when they're added.
Next pass: the escape's house fronts, toy cars and the garage, then the rain path; and the Flow batch (neighbours, dog, photo wall, calendar, Theo's drawing).
